verdict.rationale: Consensus offers a REST API and an MCP server, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for it. The evidence documents no such environment. The MCP 'Anonymous Tier' is described as a way to try the server before signing up, but it is rate-limited production access rather than an isolated test environment. That is an adjacent trial feature, not sandbox isolation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
